title: Tenant context
description: The JWT the gateway signs for every call it forwards to a service (ADR-0001, ADR-0003). See tenant-context.md. Canonical copy: RSOcc26/.github docs/contracts; repositories keep a byte-identical copy for their tests.

kid.description: JWK thumbprint of the gateway key; look it up in the gateway JWKS.

aud.description: The one service the token is for, for example service-identity.

userContext.description: A call made on behalf of a signed-in user.

sub.description: CompanyCentral user ID. Absent only before the user's first sign-in (GET /me creates the user).

tid.description: Planned: the company (tenant) the gateway validated. Services take the tenant only from here.

roles.description: Platform roles. Company roles will come from Access.

idp_iss.description: Issuer of the identity provider's token.

idp_sub.description: Subject of the identity provider's token.

idp_iat.description: When the identity provider issued its token; claims older than a stored change must not overwrite it.

serviceContext.description: A call the gateway makes for itself (for example the user lookup). Carries no user.
